reading.notes: Photo of a CD disc lying on an open booklet/digipak. The disc shows a photo of the artist, a red lipstick kiss print and the signature 'Paula Linke', plus a partially legible rights notice around the edge ('...the producer and of the owner of the recorded work reserved... public performance and broadcasting of this record prohibited'). The booklet contains photo collages, a credits block (partially covered: 'Texte & Musik: Paula Linke', 'Cello: Merle Weißbach', 'Percussion: Maria Schüritz', further names cut off, '...Jacobi', '...Mond'), a German text beginning 'Küsse, das sind wir. Wir, die wir auf dieser Erde leben, für einen kurzen Moment...' ending 'Mehr Küsse!' and 'DANKE. FÜR ALL DAS SCHÖNE!', and a lyrics page beginning 'Du weißt, dass du mit jedem Schabernack den Opa glücklich machst...' ending '...du, mein großer Superheld.' No tracklist, track numbers, durations, barcode, label or catalogue number are visible.
